text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. 59 Project Management is constructing an 18-storey condominium building at 17 Dundonald Street. The sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on Dundonald Street fronting the site are currently closed to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on February 23, 2016, approved the subject construction staging area on Dundonald Street, from January 1, 2016 to January 31, 2018. Transportation Services is requesting approval to extend the duration of the subject construction staging area from February 1, 2018 to May 31, 2018, in order to complete the construction of the development.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the continuation of the closure of the sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on the south side of Dundonald Street, between a point 155.08 metres east of Yonge Street and a point 166.0 metres west of Church Street and provision of a temporary covered and protected walkway within the closed portion of the westbound lane, from February 1, 2018 to May 31, 2018. 2. Approved the continuation of "No Stopping, Anytime" restriction on the south side of Dundonald Street, between a point 95.6 metres east of Yonge Street and a point 166.0 metres west of Church Street. 3. Directed the applicant to continue posting a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 4.
